## Setup (bench)
```sh
bench get-app https://github.com/Tacten/biograph
bench --site <site> install-app healthcare
```

## Lint and format (pre-commit, the same as CI)
```sh
pip install pre-commit
pre-commit install
npm install          # eslint deps
pre-commit run --all-files
```
The hooks run trailing-whitespace, yaml/json/toml/ast checks, prettier (js/ts/vue/css/scss), eslint, pip-audit, `ruff --fix`, `ruff-format` and detect-secrets (against the `.secrets.baseline` baseline).

## Semgrep (Frappe rules)
```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/frappe/semgrep-rules.git .frappe-semgrep-rules
pip install semgrep
semgrep ci --config ./.frappe-semgrep-rules/rules --config r/python.lang.correctness
```

## Tests (inside a bench)
```sh
bench --site test_site run-parallel-tests --app healthcare
# or for a single doctype:
bench --site <site> run-tests --app healthcare --doctype "Patient Appointment"
```

## Patient portal frontend
```sh
yarn install                 # root postinstall also installs patient_portal
yarn build                   # = cd patient_portal && yarn build (vite build --base=/assets/healthcare/patient_portal/)
cd patient_portal && yarn dev
```

## Translations
`.github/helper/update_pot_file.sh` regenerates `healthcare/locale/main.pot`. It runs in CI on a weekly schedule.
